    Module maps carried by boundary-free coefficient components #

    Every boundary-free equality component in the coefficient constraint graph defines a morphism between the corresponding string modules: put coefficient one on the component and zero elsewhere. Naturality is exactly the statement that matched-step edges carry equal coefficients and unmatched boundaries carry coefficient zero.
